content.text:
Done. Feature implemented, verified, committed, and pushed on branch `feat/sprite-account-connect`.

## What I built

A per‑sprite **Accounts** tab (in the sprite detail screen, next to Overview/Chat/Checkpoints) that detects which of the three accounts are connected *on that sprite* and lets you connect the missing ones with a straightforward browser flow.

**New files**
- `src/services/account-auth.ts` — provider metadata, credential detection, output parsers, and a sendable streaming-exec login client.
- `src/components/sprite/ConnectAccountSheet.tsx` — the guided connect modal.
- `src/components/sprite/SpriteAccountsTab.tsx` — per‑provider status + Connect/Reconnect cards.
- Wired a 4th tab into `src/app/(app)/sprite/[name].tsx`.

**How each flow works** (all run the real CLI on the sprite over the same WebSocket TTY your terminal POC uses):
- **Codex** — `codex login --device-auth` → shows the static URL + one‑time code, self‑polls. No paste‑back.
- **GitHub** — `gh auth login --web` (non‑tty, auto‑polls) + `gh auth setup-git` so `git push` works. Shows code + `github.com/login/device`.
- **Claude** — `claude setup-token` in a **wide PTY** (so the Ink TUI doesn't wrap the URL) → open the `platform.claude.com` authorize URL, paste the returned code back, which I forward into the TTY.

The modal opens the browser, shows/copies the code, and **auto‑detects completion** by watching each provider's on‑sprite credential file signature (`mtime:size`) change from a baseline — so it also makes "Reconnect" wait for a genuinely new login instead of the stale creds.

## Verification
- Parsers run against **real** `codex`/`gh`/`claude` output — all extract the right URL/code.
- Detection command run against real cred files — accurate.
- Exact non‑tty `gh` command confirmed to emit a parseable code.
- `tsc --noEmit` and `expo lint` clean.
- I could not click through the actual Expo app headlessly (no device/token here), so the RN UI itself wasn't exercised at runtime — the risky logic was verified directly instead.

## Two things to flag
1. **My probing logged Codex out on *this* dev machine** — `codex login --device-auth` clears `~/.codex/auth.json` when it starts, and my timed‑out tests never completed. GitHub and Claude are untouched. To restore it, run `! codex login` here. (This is exactly the behavior the signature‑change detection now accounts for.)
2. I kept your **in‑progress `storage.ts` → `chat-repository.ts`/SQLite refactor** entirely out of my commits — my feature was committed on top of `HEAD`, and your uncommitted refactor is preserved in the working tree. (Also: `npx expo lint` generated an untracked `eslint.config.js`; left it alone.)

PR: https://github.com/oogxdd/sprites-rn-manager/pull/new/feat/sprite-account-connect

Possible follow‑ups if you want them: auto‑open the Accounts tab for a freshly created sprite, and optionally capture a successful login to your global creds so future sprites inherit it (the app already replays global creds via `provision.ts`).
